extracted text: The paper studies a 7150 Al-Zn-Mg-Cu aluminum alloy in three different temper conditions: under aged (T4), peak aged (T6), and highly over-aged. The specimens were obtained from rolled sheet and subjected to solutionizing treatment at 475°C for 45 min, quenched in cold water, followed by artificial ageing at 120°C for 0.5 h for under aged (T4) temper and at 120°C for 24 h for peak aged (T6) temper. For highly over-aged temper, a two-step ageing treatment was used: first ageing at 120°C for 24 h then ageing at 150°C for 30 h.
